headline: Profitability rebounds sharply as revenue accelerates
summary_short: Capital One reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $15.85B (+4.1% q/q, +26.9% y/y) and net income of $3.02B, a sharp swing from a $4.28B net loss a year ago; diluted EPS was $4.73 versus an $8.58 per-share loss in Q2 2025.
summary_long: Revenue was $15.85B, up 4.1% q/q and up 26.9% y/y. Net income was $3.02B, up 38.9% q/q and a reversal from a $4.28B net loss in Q2 2025. Diluted EPS was $4.73, up 41.6% q/q and versus an $8.58 per-share loss a year ago. No margin, cash-position, or balance-sheet figures are available on the verified shard for this period.
